lastCompletedStory.title: Gate init/setup interactivity on stdin raw-mode, not only stdout.isTTY

nextStoryContext: US-002 fixes the duplicate React key in the Ink init/setup wizard render. The relevant files are src/ui/InitScreen.tsx and src/ui/SetupScreen.tsx. Look for list-rendered children without stable unique keys (typically a Box or Section rendered with createElement where multiple children share the same implicit key). The ink-testing-library pattern for asserting no console.error is already established in test/interactivity/interactivity.test.ts: use beforeAll to spy on console.error and afterAll to restore.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Ink docs (via gh api) confirm: useStdin().isRawModeSupported is the Ink-native boolean for detecting raw mode support; setRawMode will throw unless the current stdin supports raw mode. process.stdin.isTTY is the correct command-level gate (falsy in piped/non-TTY contexts). Our implementation of isInitInteractiveGate and isSetupInteractiveGate using Boolean(process.stdin.isTTY) correctly routes to the non-interactive fallback when raw mode is unavailable, matching the Ink-recommended pattern.
